title: platform-checklist docs: RUNNER.md, README.md and runs/README.md still say every completed run files a qa-run issue; ruling C on the checklist-test skill exempts verification re-runs (PR #24172) — add the exception in the three devx docs
body:
Blocked-by: #24172 (the skill half of the #24127 ruling; acceptance 1 cites its merged text — recorded by the triage seat)

Filing gate ① — agent-read protocol text made false by a maintainer ruling; the follow-up a landed ruling owes (「已落地工作欠的后续照立卡」). Reader who acts: the `domain:devx` seat (owner of `docs/qa/platform-checklist/**` by the lane table), one docs-only PR. Dedupe: MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack 「RUNNER.md every completed run files one qa-run issue verification re-run exception」 (closed included) → 157 hits, the top ten read: #24127 (the ruling card, `domain:skills`, executing in PR #24172), #24119 (closed, two other stale RUNNER facts), the rest `qa-run` records; none is this card. Filed by the `domain:skills` seat 1 (`session_012PxNHU3dfov2hbpg9ycZ8q`, marchtian) from the #24127 dev's out-of-scope finding (report 6234454492, class b, named producer: every checklist-test runner, which the skill tells to read RUNNER.md first).

## Source

The maintainer ruled **C** on #24127 (`6230593290`, 「C 有问题才开卡 (Recommended)」): a **verification re-run** — a run whose trigger is a ledger edit the same PR makes — files **no** `qa-run` record when every clause passes; its per-item table goes in the PR body and the item's `history` row names the PR; a `partial` / `blocked` gap goes in the PR body and the item's `knownGaps`; sweeps (release candidate, area or `all`, maintainer-named target) still file one record per run. PR #24172 writes that into `.claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md` §4, §5 and the Guardrails.

Three `domain:devx` documents the skill tells its runner to read first still state the pre-ruling rule, at `origin/main` `bd4276a91`:

- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md` L460–461: 「Every completed run — **pass or fail alike** — files **one GitHub issue** as its durable record, labeled `qa-run` and nothing else (extraction obligation below).」
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/runs/README.md` L11: 「**Where results go instead — every completed run files one `qa-run` GitHub issue** as its …」
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/README.md` L466–467: 「… every run files one `qa-run` GitHub issue as its record (text only: the verdict table + a reproduction …」

A runner that obeys RUNNER.md over the skill files a record the ruling says not to file; one that obeys the skill contradicts RUNNER.md. The title grammar (RUNNER.md 「The record title」) is unaffected: ruling item 2 leaves it unchanged.

## Governing text

- Ruling `6230593290` on #24127 (items 1–3), adopting the director's 口径 `6229123659`.
- `.claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md` §4 and §5 after PR #24172 (the skill's own 验证重测 definition).
- AGENTS.md Prime Directive #10 (never advertise a behaviour the system does not have; keep the claim as narrow as the enforcement) — here a procedure the fleet no longer follows.

## Premises, each with a re-check

- `git show origin/main:docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md | grep -n "pass or fail alike"` → 1 hit (L460). Control: `grep -n "The record title"` → hits.
- `git show origin/main:docs/qa/platform-checklist/runs/README.md | grep -n "every completed run files one"` → 1 hit (L11). Control: `grep -n "qa-run"` → hits.
- `git show origin/main:docs/qa/platform-checklist/README.md | grep -n "every run files"` → 1 hit (L466). Control: `grep -n "history"` → hits.
- `gh api /repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pulls/24172 --jq .merged` → the skill half lands first; this card's edit should cite the merged skill text, not the PR.

## Target

Docs only, three files, one PR: each of the three sentences gains the verification re-run exception in the ruling's words (a run triggered by the same PR's ledger edit of that item files no record; its evidence is the PR body and the item's `history` row; sweeps still file one record per run). RUNNER.md's title grammar, label discipline and extraction obligation are unchanged. No gate.

## Acceptance

1. The three sentences state the exception and agree with `.claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md` §5's 「验证重测」 paragraph as merged.
2. `pnpm check:doc-authoring` and the platform-checklist watchdog (`node scripts/check-platform-checklist-watchdog.mjs`) exit 0; `skip-changeset` applies (docs under `docs/qa/**` publish nothing).
